free_tier.stated: USD 1 of API usage a day with a free key; USD 0.10 a day with no key; the budget is priced per call, so it buys 10,000 list-and-filter calls or 1,000 searches a day, and single-entity lookups are free

chaining: Results past 10,000 for one query need cursor paging, which needs a free key; a full copy of the index comes from the quarterly S3 snapshot recorded in data-apis/openalex rather than from the API.

limits.value: 10 requests a second keyless, 30 with a free key, 50 on an annual plan

daily budget USD 1 with a free key, no payment method; prepaid usage in USD 1 increments is drawn only after the free budget runs out and expires 3 months after the most recent purchase; the budget resets every midnight UTC

identity_cost.detail: The API answers with no key on a smaller daily budget. The free key comes from an account on openalex.org or from a POST to https://api.openalex.org/api-keys with an email address, and works only once that email address is verified. No payment method required.

reliability_note: Exceeding the daily budget or the per-second limit answers 429; a per-second 429 costs nothing and clears on retry.
